01.reason: The single segment is Rava's case of Rav Sheshet and the man who voided the bill, with its proof sentence fused in; Abaye's rebuttal after it is argument.

02.reason: The single segment tells Rav Yehuda's three attempts and the gourds in the witnesses' ears; the proof sentence sits in the same segment and Rava's reply after it is argument.

03.reason: Segments 5-6 tell the widow, the gold dinar baked into bread, her oath and her son's death, ending on the Sages' remark; what follows is Gemara analysis.

04.reason: TWO STORIES: segment 5 is the widow who swore before Rav Huna and 6-8 the widow who cursed Rabba bar Rav Huna; they sit back to back, so no end can be moved without dropping one.

05.reason: One segment holds the incident of the negligent teacher whom Rav Aha removed and Ravina reinstated; the legal framing is fused into the same segment.

06.reason: Segments 5-6 tell the whole Abba bar Marta repayment episode from the debt to Rabba's closing remark; segments 4 and 7 are legal discussion.

07.reason: The single segment is the whole incident of Rabbi Abba bar Zutra's captive maidservant and the Sages' advice; the Gemara's analysis follows.

08.reason: Segments 5-6 tell Shmuel's captive maidservant and the outcome that he freed her without a bill; segment 7 is Gemara commentary.

09.reason: One segment holds the incident of Rabbi Eliezer freeing his slave to complete a quorum, with the brief answer fused in; the following baraitot are argument.

10.reason: Segments 5-6 tell Rav Nahman bar Yitzhak's inquiry and the deathbed hat case with Rav Nahman's verdict; segment 4 is a ruling and 7 onward is explanation.

11.reason: Segments 5-6 tell the slave town's case before Ravina and his exchange with the Rabbis, ending on the ruling for Ravina in the same segment; segment 7 is another site story.

12.reason: Segments 5-7 tell the half-freed slave given to a minor son and Rav Pappa's verdict on how to free him; segment 8 begins unrelated baraitot.

13.reason: Segments 5-6 hold the forced emancipation of the half-maidservant, and segment 6 supplies the cause (men took liberties with her) that answers the question fused into segment 5.

14.reason: The single segment tells Abaye's lost donkey and the Samaritans' reply; the neighbouring segments are argument or another site story.

15.reason: Segments 5-9 tell the whole Rav Ilish and Rav Nahman's daughters story from the captivity to his closing remark; segment 10 is a new mishna.

16.reason: The single segment is the case of the escaped slave before Rabbi Ami and his instruction to the master; the baraita that follows is exegesis.

17.reason: The single segment holds Rav Hisda's whole exchange with Bei Kutai over his escaped slave; segment 6 is the Gemara's question about it.

18.reason: The single segment tells the Arab merchant woman, the phylacteries thrown in the river and Abaye's regret; a mishna follows.

19.reason: Segments 5-6 tell the Bei Mikhsi residents before Rav Huna and his answer to Rabbi Abba; segment 4 is a ruling and segment 7 is another site story.

20.reason: Segments 5-8 tell the man who sold himself to gladiators, the Sages' objection and Rabbi Ami's dismissal; segment 9 starts the separate Reish Lakish story.
